verses.35: Then he showed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the LORD, while Satan stood at his right hand to accuse him.
verses.36: And the angel of the LORD said to Satan, "May the LORD rebuke you, Satan; may the LORD who has chosen Jerusalem rebuke you! Is not this man a brand snatched from the fire?"
verses.37: Now Joshua was standing before the angel, clad in filthy garments.
verses.38: He spoke and said to those who were standing before him, "Take off his filthy garments, and clothe him in festal garments."
verses.39: He also said, "Put a clean miter on his head." And they put a clean miter on his head and clothed him with the garments. Then the angel of the LORD, standing, said, "See, I have taken away your guilt."
verses.40: The angel of the LORD then gave Joshua this assurance:
verses.41: "Thus says the LORD of hosts: If you walk in my ways and heed my charge, you shall judge my house and keep my courts, and I will give you access among these standing here.
verses.42: Listen, O Joshua, high priest! You and your associates who sit before you are men of good omen. Yes, I will bring my servant the Shoot.
verses.43: Look at the stone that I have placed before Joshua, one stone with seven facets. I will engrave its inscription, says the LORD of hosts, and I will take away the guilt of the land in one day.
verses.44: On that day, says the LORD of hosts, you will invite one another under your vines and fig trees."
verses.59: Then I raised my eyes again and saw a scroll flying.
verses.60: "What do you see?" he asked me. I answered, "I see a scroll flying; it is twenty cubits long and ten cubits wide."
verses.61: Then he said to me: "This is the curse which is to go forth over the whole earth; in accordance with it shall every thief be swept away, and in accordance with it shall every perjurer be expelled from here.
verses.62: I will send it forth, says the LORD of hosts, and it shall come into the house of the thief, or into the house of him who perjures himself with my name; it shall lodge within his house, consuming it, timber and stones."
verses.63: Then the angel who spoke with me came forward and said to me, "Raise your eyes and see what this is that comes forth."
verses.64: "What is it?" I asked. And he answered, "This is a bushel container coming. This is their guilt in all the land."
verses.65: Then a leaden cover was lifted, and there was a woman sitting inside the bushel.
verses.66: "This is Wickedness," he said; and he thrust her inside the bushel, pushing the leaden cover into the opening.
verses.67: Then I raised my eyes and saw two women coming forth with a wind ruffling their wings, for they had wings like the wings of a stork. As they lifted up the bushel into the air,
verses.68: I said to the angel who spoke with me, "Where are they taking the bushel?"
verses.69: He replied, "To build a temple for it in the land of Shinar; when the temple is ready, they will deposit it there in its place."
verses.70: Again I raised my eyes and saw four chariots coming out from between two mountains; and the mountains were of bronze.
verses.71: The first chariot had red horses, the second chariot black horses,
verses.72: the third chariot white horses, and the fourth chariot spotted horses - all of them strong horses.
verses.73: I asked the angel who spoke with me, "What are these, my lord?"
verses.74: The angel said to me in reply, "These are the four winds of the heavens, which are coming forth after being reviewed by the LORD of all the earth."
verses.75: The chariot with the black horses was turning toward the land of the north, the red and the white horses went after them, and the spotted ones went toward the land of the south.
verses.76: As these strong horses emerged, eager to set about patrolling the earth, he said, "Go, patrol the earth!" Then, as they patrolled the earth,
verses.77: he called out to me and said, "See, they that go forth to the land of the north will make my spirit rest in the land of the north."
verses.78: This word of the LORD then came to me:
verses.79: Take from the returned captives Heldai, Tobijah, Jedaiah; and go the same day to the house of Josiah, son of Zephaniah (these had come from Babylon).
verses.80: Silver and gold you shall take, and make a crown; place it on the head of (Joshua, son of Jehozadak, the high priest) Zerubbabel.
verses.81: And say to him: Thus says the LORD of hosts: Here is a man whose name is Shoot, and where he is he shall sprout, and he shall build the temple of the LORD.
verses.82: Yes, he shall build the temple of the LORD, and taking up the royal insignia, he shall sit as ruler upon his throne. The priest shall be put at his right hand, and between the two of them there shall be friendly understanding.
verses.83: The crown itself shall be a memorial offering in the temple of the LORD in favor of Heldai, Tobijah, Jedaiah, and the son of Zephaniah.
verses.84: And they who are from afar shall come and build the temple of the LORD, and you shall know that the LORD of hosts has sent me to you. And if you heed carefully the voice of the LORD your God. . . .
verses.85: In the fourth year of Darius the king (the word of the LORD came to Zechariah), on the fourth day of Chislev, the ninth month,
verses.86: Bethelsarezer sent Regemmelech and his men to implore favor of the LORD
verses.87: and to ask the priests of the house of the LORD of hosts, and the prophets, "Must I mourn and abstain in the fifth month as I have been doing these many years?"
verses.88: Thereupon this word of the LORD of hosts came to me:
verses.89: Say to all the people of the land and to the priests: When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and in the seventh month these seventy years, was it really for me that you fasted?
verses.90: And when you were eating and drinking, was it not for yourselves that you ate, and for yourselves that you drank?
verses.91: Were not these the words which the LORD spoke through the former prophets, when Jerusalem and the surrounding cities were inhabited and at peace, when the Negeb and the foothills were inhabited?
verses.92: (This word of the LORD came to Zechariah:
verses.93: Thus says the LORD of hosts:) Render true judgment, and show kindness and compassion toward each other.
verses.94: Do not oppress the widow or the orphan, the alien or the poor; do not plot evil against one another in your hearts.
verses.95: But they refused to listen; they stubbornly turned their backs and stopped their ears so as not to hear.
verses.96: And they made their hearts diamondhard so as not to hear the teaching and the message that the LORD of hosts had sent by his spirit through the former prophets.
verses.97: Then the LORD of hosts in his great anger said that, as they had not listened when he called, so he would not listen when they called,
verses.98: but would scatter them with a whirlwind among all the nations that they did not know. Thus the land was left desolate after them with no one traveling to and fro; they made the pleasant land into a desert.
verses.99: This word of the LORD of hosts came: Thus says the LORD of hosts:
verses.100: I am intensely jealous for Zion, stirred to jealous wrath for her.
verses.101: Thus says the LORD: I will return to Zion, and I will dwell within Jerusalem; Jerusalem shall be called the faithful city, and the mountain of the LORD of hosts, the holy mountain.
verses.102: Thus says the LORD of hosts: Old men and old women, each with staff in hand because of old age, shall again sit in the streets of Jerusalem.
verses.103: The city shall be filled with boys and girls playing in her streets.
verses.104: Thus says the LORD of hosts: Even if this should seem impossible in the eyes of the remnant of this people, shall it in those days be impossible in my eyes also, says the LORD of hosts?
verses.105: Thus says the LORD of hosts: Lo, I will rescue my people from the land of the rising sun, and from the land of the setting sun.
verses.106: I will bring them back to dwell within Jerusalem. They shall be my people, and I will be their God, with faithfulness and justice.
verses.107: Thus says the LORD of hosts: Let your hands be strong, you who in these days hear these words spoken by the prophets on the day when the foundation of the house of the LORD of hosts was laid for the building of the temple.
verses.108: For before those days there were no wages for men, or hire for beasts; those who came and went had no security from the enemy, for I set every man against his neighbor.
verses.109: But now I will not deal with the remnant of this people as in former days, says the LORD of hosts,
verses.110: for it is the seedtime of peace: the vine shall yield its fruit, the land shall bear its crops, and the heavens shall give their dew; all these things I will have the remnant of the people possess.
verses.111: Just as you were a curse among the nations, O house of Judah and house of Israel, so will I save you that you may be a blessing; do not fear, but let your hands be strong.
verses.112: Thus says the LORD of hosts: As I determined to harm you when your fathers provoked me to wrath, says the LORD of hosts, and I did not relent,
verses.113: so again in these days I have determined to favor Jerusalem and the house of Judah; do not fear!
verses.114: These then are the things you should do: Speak the truth to one another; let there be honesty and peace in the judgments at your gates,
verses.115: and let none of you plot evil against another in his heart, nor love a false oath. For all these things I hate, says the LORD.
verses.116: This word of the LORD of hosts came to me:
verses.117: Thus says the LORD of hosts: The fast days of the fourth, the fifth, the seventh, and the tenth months shall become occasions of joy and gladness, cheerful festivals for the house of Judah; only love faithfulness and peace.
verses.118: Thus says the LORD of hosts: There shall yet come peoples, the inhabitants of many cities;
verses.119: and the inhabitants of one city shall approach those of another, and say, "Come! let us go to implore the favor of the LORD"; and, "I too will go to seek the LORD."
verses.120: Many peoples and strong nations shall come to seek the LORD of hosts in Jerusalem and to implore the favor of the LORD.
verses.121: Thus says the LORD of hosts: In those days ten men of every nationality, speaking different tongues, shall take hold, yes, take hold of every Jew by the edge of his garment and say, "Let us go with you, for we have heard that God is with you."
verses.122: An oracle: The word of the LORD is upon the land of Hadrach, and Damascus is its resting place, For the cities of Aram are the LORD'S, as are all the tribes of Israel,
verses.123: Hamath also, on its border, Tyre too, and Sidon, however wise they be.
verses.124: Tyre built herself a stronghold, and heaped up silver like dust, and gold like the mire of the streets.
verses.125: Lo, the LORD will strip her of her possessions, and smite her power on the sea, and she shall be devoured by fire.
verses.126: Ashkelon shall see it and be afraid; Gaza also: she shall be in great anguish; Ekron, too, for her hope shall come to nought. The king shall disappear from Gaza, and Ashkelon shall not be inhabited,
verses.127: and the baseborn shall occupy Ashdod. I will destroy the pride of the Philistine
verses.128: and take from his mouth his bloody meat, and his abominations from between his teeth: He also shall become a remnant for our God, and shall be like a family in Judah, and Ekron shall be like the Jebusites.
verses.129: I will encamp by my house as a guard that none may pass to and fro; No oppressor shall pass over them again, for now I have regard for their affliction.
verses.130: Rejoice heartily, O daughter Zion, shout for joy, O daughter Jerusalem! See, your king shall come to you; a just savior is he, Meek, and riding on an ass, on a colt, the foal of an ass.
verses.131: He shall banish the chariot from Ephraim, and the horse from Jerusalem; The warrior's bow shall be banished, and he shall proclaim peace to the nations. His dominion shall be from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the earth.
verses.132: As for you, for the blood of your covenant with me, I will bring forth your prisoners from the dungeon.
verses.133: In the return to the fortress of the waiting prisoners, This very day, I will return you double for your exile.
verses.134: For I will bend Judah as my bow, I will arm myself with Ephraim; I will arouse your sons, O Zion, (against your sons, O Yavan,) and I will use you as a warrior's sword.
verses.135: The LORD shall appear over them, and his arrow shall shoot forth as lightning; The LORD God shall sound the trumpet, and come in a storm from the south.
verses.136: The LORD of hosts shall be a shield over them, they shall overcome sling stones and trample them underfoot; They shall drink blood like wine, till they are filled with it like libation bowls, like the corners of the altar.
verses.137: And the LORD, their God, shall save them on that day, his people, like a flock. For they are the jewels in a crown raised aloft over his land.
verses.138: For what wealth is theirs, and what beauty! grain that makes the youths flourish, and new wine, the maidens!
verses.139: Ask of the LORD rain in the spring season! It is the LORD who makes storm clouds. And sends men the pouring rain; for everyone, grassy fields.
verses.140: For the teraphim speak nonsense, the diviners have false visions: Deceitful dreams they tell, empty comfort they offer. This is why they wander like sheep, wretched: they have no shepherd.
verses.141: My wrath is kindled against the shepherds, and I will punish the leaders; For the LORD of hosts will visit his flock, the house of Judah, and make them his stately war horse.
verses.142: From him shall come leader and chief, from him warrior's bow and every officer.
verses.143: They shall all be warriors, trampling the mire of the streets in battle; They shall wage war because the LORD is with them, and shall put the horsemen to rout.
verses.144: I will strengthen the house of Judah, the house of Joseph I will save; I will bring them back, because I have mercy on them, they shall be as though I had never cast them off, for I am the LORD, their God, and I will hear them.
verses.145: Then Ephraim shall be valiant men, and their hearts shall be cheered as by wine. Their children shall see it and be glad, their hearts shall rejoice in the LORD.
verses.146: I will whistle for them to come together, and when I redeem them they will be as numerous as before.
verses.147: I sowed them among the nations, yet in distant lands they remember me; they shall rear their children and return.
verses.148: I will bring them back from the land of Egypt, and gather them from Assyria. I will bring them into Gilead and into Lebanon, but these shall not suffice them;
verses.149: I will cross over to Egypt and smite the waves of the sea and all the depths of the Nile shall be dried up. The pride of Assyria shall be cast down, and the scepter of Egypt taken away.
verses.150: I will strengthen them in the LORD, and they shall walk in his name, says the LORD.
verses.151: Open your doors, O Lebanon, that the fire may devour your cedars!
verses.152: Wail, you cypress trees, for the cedars are fallen, the mighty have been despoiled. Wail, you oaks of Bashan, for the impenetrable forest is cut down!
verses.153: Hark! the wailing of the shepherds, their glory has been ruined. Hark! the roaring of the young lions, the jungle of the Jordan is laid waste.
verses.154: Thus said the LORD, my God: Shepherd the flock to be slaughtered.
verses.155: For they who buy them slay them with impunity; while those who sell them say, "Blessed be the LORD, I have become rich!" Even their own shepherds do not feel for them.
verses.156: (Nor shall I spare the inhabitants of the earth any more, says the LORD. Yes, I will deliver each of them into the power of his neighbor, or into the power of his king; they shall crush the earth, and I will not deliver it out of their power.
verses.157: So I became the shepherd of the flock to be slaughtered for the sheep merchants. I took two staffs, one of which I called "Favor," and the other, "Bonds," and I fed the flock.
verses.158: In a single month I did away with the three shepherds. I wearied of them, and they behaved badly toward me.
verses.159: "I will not feed you," I said. "What is to die, let it die; what is to perish, let it perish, and let those that are left devour one another's flesh."
verses.160: Then I took my staff "Favor" and snapped it asunder, breaking off the covenant which I had made with all peoples;
verses.161: that day it was broken off. The sheep merchants who were watching me understood that this was the word of the LORD.
verses.162: I said to them, "If it seems good to you, give me my wages; but if not, let it go." And they counted out my wages, thirty pieces of silver.
verses.163: But the LORD said to me, "Throw it in the treasury, the handsome price at which they valued me." So I took the thirty pieces of silver and threw them into the treasury in the house of the LORD.
verses.164: Then I snapped asunder my other staff, "Bonds," breaking off the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.
verses.165: The LORD said to me: This time take the gear of a foolish shepherd.
verses.166: For I will raise up a shepherd in the land who will take no note of those that perish, nor seek the strays, nor heal the injured, nor feed what survives - he will eat the flesh of the fat ones and tear off their hoofs!
verses.167: Woe to my foolish shepherd who forsakes the flock! May the sword fall upon his arm and upon his right eye; Let his arm wither away entirely, and his right eye be blind forever!
verses.168: An oracle: the word of the LORD concerning Israel. Thus says the LORD, who spreads out the heavens, lays the foundations of the earth, and forms the spirit of man within him:
verses.169: See, I will make Jerusalem a bowl to stupefy all peoples round about. (Judah will be besieged, even Jerusalem.
verses.170: On that day I will make Jerusalem a weighty stone for all peoples. All who attempt to lift it shall injure themselves badly, and all the nations of the earth shall be gathered against her.
verses.171: On that day, says the LORD, I will strike every horse with fright, and its rider with madness. I will strike blind all the horses of the peoples, but upon the house of Judah I will open my eyes,
verses.172: and the princes of Judah shall say to themselves, "The inhabitants of Jerusalem have their strength in the LORD of hosts, their God."
verses.173: On that day I will make the princes of Judah like a brazier of fire in the woodland, and like a burning torch among sheaves, and they shall devour right and left all the surrounding peoples; but Jerusalem shall still abide on its own site.
verses.174: The LORD shall save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of the house of David and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem may not be exalted over Judah.
verses.175: On that day, the LORD will shield the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the weakling among them shall be like David on that day, and the house of David godlike, like an angel of the LORD before them.
verses.176: On that day I will seek the destruction of all nations that come against Jerusalem.
verses.177: I will pour out on the house of David and on the inhabitants of Jerusalem a spirit of grace and petition; and they shall look on him whom they have thrust through, and they shall mourn for him as one mourns for an only son, and they shall grieve over him as one grieves over a first-born.
verses.178: On that day the mourning in Jerusalem shall be as great as the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the plain of Megiddo.
verses.179: And the land shall mourn, each family apart: the family of the house of David, and their wives; the family of the house of Nathan, and their wives;
verses.180: the family of the house of Levi, and their wives; the family of Shemei, and their wives;
verses.181: and all the rest of the families, each family apart, and the wives apart.
verses.182: Lo, a day shall come for the LORD when the spoils shall be divided in your midst.
verses.183: And I will gather all the nations against Jerusalem for battle: the city shall be taken, houses plundered, women ravished; half of the city shall go into exile, but the rest of the people shall not be removed from the city.
verses.184: Then the LORD shall go forth and fight against those nations, fighting as on a day of battle.
verses.185: That day his feet shall rest upon the Mount of Olives, which is opposite Jerusalem to the east. The Mount of Olives shall be cleft in two from east to west by a very deep valley, and half of the mountain shall move to the north and half of it to the south.
verses.186: And the valley of the LORD'S mountain shall be filled up when the valley of those two mountains reaches its edge; it shall be filled up as it was filled up by the earthquake in the days of King Uzziah of Judah. Then the LORD, my God, shall come, and all his holy ones with him.
verses.187: On that day there shall no longer be cold or frost.
verses.188: There shall be one continuous day, known to the LORD, not day and night, for in the evening time there shall be light.
verses.189: On that day, living waters shall flow from Jerusalem, half to the eastern sea, and half to the western sea, and it shall be so in summer and in winter.
verses.190: The LORD shall become king over the whole earth; on that day the LORD shall be the only one, and his name the only one.
verses.191: And from Geba to Rimmon in the Negeb, all the land shall turn into a plain; but Jerusalem shall remain exalted in its place. From the Gate of Benjamin to the place of the First Gate, to the Corner Gate; and from the Tower of Hananel to the king's wine presses,
verses.192: they shall occupy her. Never again shall she be doomed; Jerusalem shall abide in security.
verses.193: And this shall be the plague with which the LORD shall strike all the nations that have fought against Jerusalem: their flesh shall rot while they stand upon their feet, and their eyes shall rot in their sockets, and their tongues shall rot in their mouths.
verses.194: On that day there shall be among them a great tumult from the LORD: every man shall seize the hand of his neighbor, and the hand of each shall be raised against that of his neighbor.
verses.195: Judah also shall fight against Jerusalem. The riches of all the surrounding nations shall be gathered together, gold, silver, and garments, in great abundance.
verses.196: Similar to this plague shall be the plague upon the horses, mules, camels, asses, and upon all the beasts that are in those camps.
verses.197: All who are left of all the nations that came against Jerusalem shall come up year after year to worship the King, the LORD of hosts, and to celebrate the feast of Booths.
verses.198: If any of the families of the earth does not come up to Jerusalem to worship the King, the LORD of hosts, no rain shall fall upon them.
verses.199: And if the family of Egypt does not come up, or enter, upon them shall fall the plague which the LORD will inflict upon all the nations that do not come up to celebrate the feast of Booths.
verses.200: This shall be the punishment of Egypt, and the punishment of all the nations that do not come up to celebrate the feast of Booths.
verses.201: On that day there shall be upon the bells of the horses, "Holy to the LORD." The pots in the house of the LORD shall be as the libation bowls before the altar.
verses.202: And every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah shall be holy to the LORD of hosts; and all who come to sacrifice shall take them and cook in them. On that day there shall no longer be any merchant in the house of the LORD of hosts.
